name: medicare-oh
title: Ohio Medicare Advantage and Part D plans, 2026
summary: Read Ohio's 2026 Medicare Advantage and Part D plan files from CMS: premiums, the Part D benefit, service areas, special needs plans, star ratings, enrollment and the out-of-pocket maximum.
description: Each task gives the AI extracts of four public CMS files on Ohio's Medicare Advantage and stand-alone Part D plans, and states its facts in the question, including any federal figure it needs, such as the standard Part D deductible. It asks for exact answers: a premium component, a count of plans, a list of plan segments or counties, a star rating, an enrollment total, or a finding in the files themselves. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Premium lookup
families.what: The Part C, Part D basic and supplemental premiums of the right plan segment, with negative premiums in parentheses.

families.name: Premium components
families.what: How the consolidated and low-income premiums are built from their parts, across every plan in the state.

families.name: Zero-premium plans
families.what: Which plans charge no premium, by category and county, and what else they charge.

families.name: Part D benefit
families.what: Deductibles, the tiers they don't apply to and spending up to the out-of-pocket threshold, with the federal figures given.

families.name: Part B premium reduction
families.what: Which plans reduce the Part B premium, by how much, and what a member pays with and without it.

families.name: Out-of-pocket maximum
families.what: In-network and combined out-of-pocket maximums by plan type, read from the right file.

families.name: Service area
families.what: Which counties a plan segment serves, and every plan open to the people of one county.

families.name: Special needs plans
families.what: Special needs plans by type, how far the plans for people with both Medicare and Medicaid are integrated, and the conditions they target.

families.name: Star ratings
families.what: Contract and plan star ratings, joined across two files that write contract IDs and ratings differently.

families.name: Enrollment
families.what: Enrollment by plan and county, added up without guessing the counts CMS hides.

families.name: Checking the files
families.what: Where the files disagree with each other, told apart from figures that only look wrong.
